scheme_name: Adivasi Sanskriti Evam Kala Kendra/Majhi Bhavan, Manki Munda Bhavan, Parha Bhavan, Pargana Bhavan, Dumkuria Bhavan Evam Gosade Nirman Tatha Majhi Than Shed Nirman Yojana
other_conditions: The applicant must represent a village with a significant tribal population.
The village must have recognized traditional tribal leaders such as Manki, Munda, or Pahan.
The beneficiary committee must be formed under the leadership of tribal leaders and consist of 7 to 11 tribal members.
The village must have government‑approved land for the construction of the infrastructure.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of ₹2.5 million to ₹5 million per project for building cultural hubs and related infrastructure in tribal villages.
